params.caption: 🕹️ PS5's AI upscaling QSSR is coming to more games Sony has announced that several more titles are getting a Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR) upgrade on the base PS5. QSSR arrived in September as an AI-guided upscaler in the same family as the PS5 Pro's PSSR, aiming for sharper image quality without the Pro hardware. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 17:47 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @PlayStation 👍 React if your PS5 needs this · 💬 Which game should get it next? #PS5 #QSSR #PlayStation #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
